scope: Metadata/documents/previous receipts only. No archive extraction, image decode, live transfer access, role mutation, training, or fresh payload-hash verification. Claims describe bound existing evidence, not a new source re-audit.
conclusion: No acquired/admitted cohort currently combines glioma MRI/CT with independently withheld vascular, functional and physical surgical truth. Component-paired studies are possible after their specific gates.

rows.paired_acquired: Eight source-linked T1/tumor-annotation cases; PAT28 additionally has AP DWI, reverse-PA b0 and gradients. No CT, patient task-fMRI/DES, or vascular truth established.
rows.fixed_roles: TRAIN PAT05/16/20/22/25/28; SELECT PAT26/27; unopened development-transfer PAT29/31; all visits and derivatives grouped by BTC participant_id.
rows.withheld_truth: Source tumor annotation can be evaluator-only in a scan-only task. Tracts reconstructed from DWI are estimates, not independent functional truth. PAT28 alone cannot establish between-patient missing-modality transfer.
rows.rights: Pinned source CC0; TVB derivatives separately say PDDL v1.0; upstream model rights/ancestry remain distinct.
rows.qc: Fractional labels, affine handling, brain support, diffusion correction/registration and functional coverage require task-specific gates. Existing source masks must not leak through target-dependent crops/proposals.

rows.paired_acquired: 199 TRAIN people / 210 sessions have acquired T1 and TOF-MRA, 840 original files. 204 image pairs from 193 people pass header/scalar QC; six T1 conflicts retained. 144 aneurysm-region masks from 106 people/117 sessions acquired; 136 grid-pass, eight unresolved.
rows.fixed_roles: 199 TRAIN, 43 SELECT, 42 MEASUREMENT_EVAL people; all visits/TopCoW derivatives inherit person role. Current documented payload intake is TRAIN.
rows.withheld_truth: TOF can be a withheld acquired modality after T1/TOF alignment qualification. Labels are aneurysm-positive regions, not a complete vessel mask or safe background. Of 144 masks, 111 subtype unresolved, 31 exact-date crosswalk mismatch, two exact voxelwise crosswalks (476,478); 478 grid fails. Only sub476 currently combines exact voxelwise linkage with passed mask-grid qualification.
rows.rights: Pinned release CC0. TopCoW external derivative annotation rights and model-assisted lineage are not inherited automatically.
rows.qc: TOF sidecar/NIfTI scanner orientation and T1/TOF alignment unresolved; no scanner-frame, training or planning admission. sub476 normalization supports retrospective component inspection only; unknown label/review availability and background remain.

rows.paired_acquired: 180 brain MRI/CT identities in publisher inventory; archive campaign is opaque/unverified in the latest audited receipt. Zero decoded or scientifically admitted pairs. Partial transfer bytes are not acquired verified patient evidence.
rows.fixed_roles: 126 TRAIN / 27 SELECT / 27 MEASUREMENT_EVAL; 42/9/9 per anonymous center. Every CT/MRI/outline/derivative inherits subject role; no held-out-center claim.
rows.withheld_truth: Same-person acquired CT could independently evaluate MRI-only estimates of CT intensities or qualified bone geometry. It supplies no vessel/function/tool-force truth. Released outline is not skull, tumor or vessel ground truth.
rows.rights: CC BY-NC 4.0 for noncommercial research; preserve exact version and attribution. No commercial permission inferred.
rows.qc: Must finish archive size/MD5/SHA256 verification before any separately admitted extraction. Rigid registration, defacing/cropping, calvarium coverage, CT scaling, lineage and source-family overlap unresolved. Release is processed acquired imaging, not synthetic-CT output or native DICOM.

rows.paired_acquired: Across 14 TRAIN people: 70 acquired original MRI/US images and 59 correspondence files. 25 visible-cavity US/mask pairs from 13 people passed structural QC; Case11 labels absent and Case15 during label absent. Additional MRI/landmark frame/anatomical qualification remains.
rows.fixed_roles: TRAIN Case2/3/5/7/11/12/15/16/17/18/21/23/24/25; SELECT 1/6/14/26; MEASUREMENT_EVAL 8/13/19/27; previously exposed Case4 DEVELOPMENT, excluded from component learner.
rows.withheld_truth: Within-person US and manual landmarks support observed cavity/correspondence tasks. Protected Case4 B/V partition: six conditioning IDs 1,14,8,17,19,7 and 13 V IDs. V must stay sealed under its contract. No synchronized tool/action/load or force truth; no complete removed-tissue truth.
rows.rights: Original MRI/US/landmarks CC BY 4.0; RESECT-SEG cavity annotations CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, source version 1 revision-2 masks.
rows.qc: Cavity masks use manual slices, interpolation, refinement and surgeon review; they can omit blood-filled ambiguous regions. Later US unavailable to preoperative policy. Sparse landmarks are conditional displacement targets, not dense mechanical truth. Case4 mesh/frame/numerical gates remain separate.

rows.fixed_roles: Existing development case; all ReMIND2Reg/visit derivatives must inherit same person.
rows.withheld_truth: Manual tumor SEG is same-source annotation, not function/vessel/mechanics truth. T1/T2 have different frame identifiers; not yet a qualified multimodal common-frame truth pair.
rows.rights: CC BY 4.0; automatic cerebrum label ancestry/meaning remain explicit.
rows.qc: No explicit source SOP-instance references in SEG; release names and frame IDs provide limited linkage. Sampled overlays do not establish whole-volume anatomy or cortical access.

rows.fixed_roles: HBE_01 DEVELOPMENT including all sibling specimens; compression/tension c3 calibration, torsion held out. VitalDB DEVELOPMENT. MULTIS proposed donor004 development, not enacted.
